intro: [Biohacking is](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/what-is-biohacking), first of all, the use of available tools to improve one’s parameters. However, despite technological advances, the development of medicine, and the pairing of biology, chemistry, and neural networks into a unified whole, medicine is aimed at treating disease. Body biohacking has emerged as a secondary phenomenon for those who want to improve themselves. One is first confronted with the desire to get fast results in huge quantities. But it doesn’t work that way, and side effects can occur. That’s where botanical biohacking comes in. Their main property is that they do not affect receptors directly but are freely available in the body, acting indirectly on cells if necessary.
highlights: Botanical biohacking supports long-term health through cellular processes.
Bacopa Monnieri boosts learning by enhancing neural connections.
Eleutherococcus improves focus, memory, and reduces mental fatigue.

blocks.text: Best botanical biohacking practices

Pharm drugs are oriented to work with receptors. Their task is to interfere with processes already taking place in the body and regulate them in a specific and defined way. Therefore, painkillers act quickly, as do remedies that help dissolve blood clots or relieve edema.

The action of herbal supplements is mediated by cellular processes that take weeks and months to take effect. When an herbal adaptogen enters the body, it is used as fuel. Everything depends on how efficiently the cell assimilates it.

The most valuable thing about biohacking plants’ adaptogens is the synergistic effect. Pharma is difficult to combine because the side effects overlap, and the active ingredients can conflict. Biohacking and plants are linked differently:

items: Plant adaptogens are precisely that, energizing different physiological processes that underlie completely different properties. These include blood flow through blood vessels, nutrition for neurons, and acetylcholine synthesis. Each of these plants interacts with these processes in its own way. And the end result is a unified nootropic effect.

Can these same elements be used separately? Of course, yes, but the impact of each of them separately will feel worse. That is why synergy between them is so important, which provides a comprehensive boost to the body.

Quick effect, powerful results, a feeling of fullness – all this is NOT present when using botanical biohacking adaptogens. They are precisely that; they saturate and energize the body, [helping you win in the long run](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/how-biohacking-can-reverse-aging).
Plant adaptogens and [supplements](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/best-biohacking-supplements), mushrooms, and their active ingredients are the fuel you fill your body’s gas tank with.

Best botanical biohacking plants
The following supplements have proven to be the best for increasing productivity:
Bacopa Monnieri

Effectively triggers the growth mechanism of dendrites – the basis for forming more complex neural connections, allowing you to absorb information and learn new things faster. Possesses antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. Restores synaptic activity and shows great potential in improving cognitive disorders, as well as in prophylactically reducing oxidative damage, modulating new neural connections, and improving cognitive function in healthy individuals.
Eleutherococcus

Many people have heard of it, but not everyone knows that Eleutherococcus also increases mental alertness in addition to its adaptogenic properties. It is actively involved in increasing mental and physical performance and is excellent at reducing fatigue and overexertion. Researchers have found that Eleutherococcus compounds improve learning and memory because they help the body process choline and synthesize more acetylcholine in the hippocampus.

Gotu Kola

Activator of BDNF and NGF factors, due to which it is used as an element in the therapy of Alzheimer’s disease. Increases neuronal nutrition, affecting nerve cell division while protecting them from death. The effectiveness of folic acid and Gotu Kola has also been compared to improve cognitive function in people after a stroke. The Gotu Kola extract was more effective than folic acid and improved short-term memory.
Lemongrass

Valuable due to the content of lignans and specific polysaccharides. It is due to them that lemongrass has such a wide range of actions, namely adaptogenic action, stimulation of the CNS, and hepatoprotective effect.

The benefit for the CNS is due to lemongrass’s neuroprotective effect. Lignans, which are present in lemongrass’s composition, improve memory and perception speed. Also, lemongrass can reduce depression through the gut-brain axis.

Rhodiola, like Eleutherococcus extract, helps relieve fatigue syndromes faster. Rhodiola extract + Eleutherococcus drops = fast recovery. Botanical biohacking wind tea

Botanical biohacking’s Wind tea is a specialized herbal tea designed to address symptoms related to “wind” imbalances, a concept from traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) often linked to issues like headaches, dizziness, sinus congestion, and even seasonal allergies. The tea combines specific herbs believed to disperse internal and external wind and alleviate symptoms by restoring balance to the body.
Key features and benefits of Wind Tea:

items: Helps clear sinus congestion: the herbs in Wind Tea work to relieve nasal and sinus congestion, providing relief from headaches and discomfort.
Supports immune function: this tea addresses “wind” pathogens, designed to help the body maintain resilience during seasonal transitions, such as spring and autumn.
Calms headache and dizziness: ingredients aim to alleviate symptoms of dizziness or lightheadedness often associated with wind imbalances.

To sum up

Botanical biohacking presents a robust, sustainable approach to enhancing health and resilience. Rather than targeting receptors for immediate effects, plant-based adaptogens work synergistically, gradually strengthening the body’s cellular processes. Essential plants provide multi-dimensional support, from cognitive enhancement to stress relief, enabling the body to adapt naturally to environmental stressors. With a focus on long-term wellness over instant fixes, botanical biohacking underscores the potential of nature’s remedies in building enduring health. Try botanical supplements correctly and step-by-step – you need the best result, not just a quick one.
